  &quot;plan&quot;: &quot;# Integrate SubscriptionsService into trainer\n\n## Overview\nThis plan implements the complete integration of &#96;SubscriptionsService&#96; from &#96;trainer_backend&#96; into the &#96;trainer&#96; app following Clean Architecture. It includes creating subscription models, building the full feature architecture (DataSource, Repository, Use Cases, Controller), updating &#96;AthleteEntity&#96; with subscription data, and integrating subscription retrieval in the authentication flow.\n\n## Implementation Steps\n\n### Part 1: Backend Models (trainer_backend)\n\n#### 1. Create ProductSummary Model\n**File**: &#96;trainer_backend/lib/models/subscriptions/product_summary.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a new model to represent the product information returned by &#96;get_user_subscription_summary&#96;:\n- &#96;id&#96; (String)\n- &#96;productId&#96; (String, from &#96;product_id&#96;)\n- &#96;vendor&#96; (String)\n- &#96;periodInterval&#96; (String?, from &#96;period_interval&#96;)\n\nFollow the same pattern as other subscription models with &#96;@JsonSerializable(fieldRename: FieldRename.snake)&#96; and &#96;@CopyWith()&#96;.\n\n#### 2. Create SubscriptionSummary Model\n**File**: &#96;trainer_backend/lib/models/subscriptions/subscription_summary.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a model representing the complete subscription summary structure:\n- &#96;id&#96; (String) - subscription ID\n- &#96;userId&#96; (String, from &#96;user_id&#96;)\n- &#96;status&#96; (SubscriptionStatus) - use &#96;@SubscriptionStatusConverter()&#96;\n- &#96;startedAt&#96; (DateTime, from &#96;started_at&#96;)\n- &#96;expiresAt&#96; (DateTime?, from &#96;expires_at&#96;)\n- &#96;isTrial&#96; (bool, from &#96;is_trial&#96;)\n- &#96;entitlement&#96; (Entitlement) - nested object\n- &#96;product&#96; (ProductSummary?) - nullable nested object\n- &#96;limits&#96; (SubscriptionLimits) - nested object\n\nUse &#96;@JsonSerializable(fieldRename: FieldRename.snake)&#96; and &#96;@CopyWith()&#96;.\n\n#### 3. Create FeatureAccessResult Model\n**File**: &#96;trainer_backend/lib/models/subscriptions/feature_access_result.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a model to replace the &#96;Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;&#96; return type of &#96;checkFeatureAccess()&#96;:\n- &#96;hasAccess&#96; (bool, from &#96;has_access&#96;)\n- &#96;featureKey&#96; (String, from &#96;feature_key&#96;)\n- &#96;limits&#96; (SubscriptionLimits?) - nullable nested object\n\nUse &#96;@JsonSerializable(fieldRename: FieldRename.snake)&#96; and &#96;@CopyWith()&#96;.\n\n#### 4. Update SubscriptionsService\n**File**: &#96;trainer_backend/lib/services/subscriptions.service.dart&#96;\n\nModify methods to use new models:\n- &#96;getUserSubscriptionSummary()&#96;: Change return type from &#96;Future&lt;Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;?&gt;&#96; to &#96;Future&lt;SubscriptionSummary?&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;checkFeatureAccess()&#96;: Change return type from &#96;Future&lt;Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;&gt;&#96; to &#96;Future&lt;FeatureAccessResult&gt;&#96;\n- Parse responses using the respective model&#39;s &#96;fromJson()&#96; methods\n- Keep &#96;null&#96; returns where appropriate\n\n#### 5. Export New Models\n**File**: &#96;trainer_backend/lib/models/models.export.dart&#96;\n\nAdd exports for:\n- &#96;subscriptions/product_summary.dart&#96;\n- &#96;subscriptions/subscription_summary.dart&#96;\n- &#96;subscriptions/feature_access_result.dart&#96;\n\n### Part 2: Feature Architecture (trainer)\n\n#### 6. Create Subscription Entity\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/domain/entities/subscription.entity.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a domain entity that wraps &#96;SubscriptionSummary&#96; from backend:\n- Use &#96;SubscriptionSummary&#96; directly or create a wrapper entity if needed\n- Follow the pattern of other entities with &#96;@CopyWith()&#96;\n\n#### 7. Create Subscription DataSource\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/data/datasources/subscription.datasource.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a data source that calls &#96;SubscriptionsService&#96; methods:\n- &#96;getUserSubscriptionSummary()&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.getUserSubscriptionSummary()&#96;\n- &#96;checkFeatureAccess({required String featureKey})&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.checkFeatureAccess()&#96;\n- &#96;configureRevenueCat({required String apiKey, required String userId})&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.configureRevenueCat()&#96;\n- &#96;getOfferings()&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.getOfferings()&#96;\n- &#96;purchasePackage({required Package package})&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.purchasePackage()&#96;\n- &#96;restorePurchases()&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.restorePurchases()&#96;\n- &#96;getCustomerInfo()&#96; → calls &#96;SubscriptionsService.getCustomerInfo()&#96;\n\nFollow the pattern of &#96;AuthDataSource&#96; with &#96;const&#96; constructor and &#96;@riverpod&#96; provider.\n\n#### 8. Create Subscription Mapper\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/data/mappers/subscription.mapper.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a mapper to convert between backend models and domain entities:\n- &#96;toEntity(SubscriptionSummary model)&#96; → &#96;SubscriptionEntity&#96;\n- &#96;fromEntity(SubscriptionEntity entity)&#96; → &#96;SubscriptionSummary&#96; (if needed)\n\n#### 9. Create Subscription Repository Interface\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/domain/repositories/subscription.repository.dart&#96;\n\nDefine abstract repository interface with methods:\n- &#96;Future&lt;SubscriptionSummary?&gt; getUserSubscriptionSummary()&#96;\n- &#96;Future&lt;FeatureAccessResult&gt; checkFeatureAccess({required String featureKey})&#96;\n- &#96;Future&lt;void&gt; configureRevenueCat({required String apiKey, required String userId})&#96;\n- &#96;Future&lt;Offerings?&gt; getOfferings()&#96;\n- &#96;Future&lt;CustomerInfo&gt; purchasePackage({required Package package})&#96;\n- &#96;Future&lt;CustomerInfo&gt; restorePurchases()&#96;\n- &#96;Future&lt;CustomerInfo&gt; getCustomerInfo()&#96;\n\nNote: &#96;Offerings&#96; and &#96;CustomerInfo&#96; are RevenueCat SDK types, kept as-is.\n\n#### 10. Create Subscription Repository Implementation\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/data/repositories/subscription.repository.impl.dart&#96;\n\nImplement the repository:\n- Inject &#96;SubscriptionDataSource&#96; via constructor\n- Implement all methods from interface\n- Use mapper for &#96;SubscriptionSummary&#96; conversions\n- Follow the pattern of &#96;AuthRepositoryImpl&#96;\n\n#### 11. Create Subscription Use Cases\n**Files**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/domain/use_cases/&#96;\n\nCreate use cases for each repository method:\n- &#96;get_user_subscription_summary.use_case.dart&#96;\n- &#96;check_feature_access.use_case.dart&#96;\n- &#96;configure_revenue_cat.use_case.dart&#96;\n- &#96;get_offerings.use_case.dart&#96;\n- &#96;purchase_package.use_case.dart&#96;\n- &#96;restore_purchases.use_case.dart&#96;\n- &#96;get_customer_info.use_case.dart&#96;\n\nFollow the pattern of &#96;getUserDataUseCase&#96; with &#96;@riverpod&#96; annotation.\n\n#### 12. Create Subscription Controller\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/subscriptions/presentation/controllers/subscription.controller.dart&#96;\n\nCreate a Riverpod controller to manage subscription state:\n- Use &#96;@riverpod&#96; annotation\n- Expose methods for subscription operations\n- Manage loading/error states\n- Follow the pattern of &#96;AuthController&#96;\n\n### Part 3: Integration with Auth\n\n#### 13. Update AthleteEntity\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/auth/domain/entities/athlete.entity.dart&#96;\n\nAdd new field:\n- &#96;subscription&#96; (SubscriptionSummary?, nullable) - default to &#96;null&#96; in constructor\n\nUpdate constructor to include the new optional parameter.\n\n#### 14. Update getUserDataUseCase\n**File**: &#96;trainer/lib/features/auth/domain/use_cases/get_user_data.use_case.dart&#96;\n\nModify the use case to:\n- Call &#96;authRepositoryProvider.getUserData()&#96; to get &#96;AthleteEntity&#96;\n- Call &#96;getUserSubscriptionSummaryUseCaseProvider().future&#96; in parallel (using &#96;Future.wait&#96;)\n- Combine results by creating a new &#96;AthleteEntity&#96; with &#96;copyWith(subscription: subscriptionSummary)&#96;\n- Handle the case where subscription is &#96;null&#96; (user has no active subscription)\n\n### Part 4: Code Generation\n\n#### 15. Run Code Generation\nAfter creating all models and entities, run:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd trainer_backend\ndart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen in trainer:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd trainer\ndart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Notes\n- &#96;SubscriptionSummary&#96; is nullable because &#96;getUserSubscriptionSummary()&#96; returns &#96;null&#96; when no active subscription exists\n- RevenueCat SDK types (&#96;Offerings&#96;, &#96;CustomerInfo&#96;, &#96;Package&#96;) are kept as-is in the repository interface (no domain entities for these)\n- The use case combines data from two sources (Profile and SubscriptionSummary) to create a complete &#96;AthleteEntity&#96;\n- All new models follow the existing patterns in &#96;trainer_backend&#96; with proper JSON serialization\n- The feature architecture follows Clean Architecture principles with clear separation between data, domain, and presentation layers&quot;,
